title: Hubbard--Heisenberg Thermodynamic Comparison at Half Filling in a Fixed Staggered Field
summary: We study the repulsive Hubbard model at half filling in the strong-coupling regime, with a staggered magnetic field of strength \(h\). The analysis is carried out in the canonical half-filled ensemble, with temperature measured on the Heisenberg scale \(J_0(U)=4t^2/U\). Uniformly for \(|h|\le h_0\) and \(βJ_0(U)\ge \ell_0\), we prove finite-volume Hubbard--Heisenberg pressure estimates with errors uniform in the system size.
